# Core Summary
A 10-second vertical action sequence set in a dimly lit underground parking garage, featuring a young delivery man (<ID_A>) defending himself against two debt collectors (<ID_B>, <ID_C>) near an elevator. The clip utilizes a 3-shot multi-shot progression to compress the fight choreography into a high-tension micro-arc. Shot 1 captures the initial ambush and box smash counterattack; Shot 2 focuses on the low-angle sweep kick takedown; Shot 3 concludes with the protagonist retreating to the elevator door and assuming a defensive stance.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:04] Underground parking garage corner, concrete pillars with peeling paint, metal elevator doors in background. A flickering motion-sensor fluorescent light overhead casts erratic, strobing shadows. Dust motes dance in the harsh beams. Audio: Low electrical buzz, distant dripping water, heavy ambient silence before sudden movement.
[shot2][00:04-00:07] Same location, lower camera angle focusing on the floor and legs. Scattered cardboard debris from the previous impact lies on the grease-stained concrete. Lighting remains inconsistent, creating high-contrast silhouettes. Audio: Continues with added scuffing of shoes on concrete.
[shot3][00:07-00:10] Same location, wider view showing the elevator alcove. The metal doors reflect the flickering light. The space feels claustrophobic. Audio: Elevator chime ding (distant), heavy breathing, tension hum.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>: Male, East Asian, young adult (20s). Wearing a worn blue-grey delivery uniform with reflective strips, matching cap, dark cargo pants, and sneakers. Carries a cardboard delivery box. Athletic build, agile. Vocal Characteristics: Sharp exhales, grunts of exertion, heavy rhythmic breathing.
<ID_B>: Male, East Asian, middle-aged (30s-40s). Rough appearance, dark leather jacket, jeans, messy hair. Aggressive posture. Vocal Characteristics: Aggressive shouting, guttural roars.
<ID_C>: Male, East Asian, middle-aged (30s-40s). Similar rough attire to <ID_B>, slightly stockier. Vocal Characteristics: Grunts of pain, heavy footsteps.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:04] Handheld camera shakes violently. <ID_B> lunges from screen-left toward center, reaching to grab <ID_A>'s collar. <ID_A>, positioned center-back near the elevator, ducks under the arm, pivots hips right, and swings the cardboard box upward with both hands. The box impacts <ID_B>'s face; cardboard bursts open, envelopes fly into the air. <ID_B> recoils backward, clutching face. Camera snaps zoom on the exploding box. Sound: Fabric rustle, cardboard crunch, muffled thud, <ID_B> roaring.
[shot2][00:04-00:07] Low angle shot. <ID_C> rushes in from screen-right, throwing a punch downward. <ID_A> drops center of gravity instantly, right leg extends low and sweeps <ID_C>'s ankles. <ID_C> loses balance, falling backward onto the concrete. <ID_A> immediately pushes off the ground to stand. Sound: Shoe scuff, heavy body thud, <ID_C> grunting.
[shot3][00:07-00:10] Medium shot. <ID_A> slides feet backward toward the elevator doors, hand reaches back to push the elevator button or check the handle. He spins 180 degrees, back now against the metal door frame, fists raised in a defensive guard. He breathes heavily, eyes locked forward. The light flickers intensely. Sound: Metal slide, sharp inhale, electrical buzz peaks.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Visual style is gritty action-thriller, reminiscent of handheld crime cinema. Color palette is desaturated cool greens and greys, punctuated by the harsh white-yellow of the flickering light. High contrast lighting (chiaroscuro) emphasizes muscle tension and debris. Texture is raw—concrete, cardboard, metal. Image quality is sharp but with motion blur to enhance speed. No resolution tags.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Atmosphere is suffocating and tense, driven by the unreliable lighting and confined space. Emotion shifts from sudden panic to calculated aggression, ending on a precarious standoff. The viewer should feel the claustrophobia and the adrenaline of the fight.
